arXiv:2606.03904v1 [cs.LG] 2026 年 6 月 2 日arXiv:2606.03904v1 [cs.LG] 02 Jun 2026

MAdam：度量感知多目标 AdamMAdam: Metric-Aware Multi-Objective Adam

Fengbei Liu1  Rachit Saluja1  Sunwoo Kwak1  Ruibo Wang3  Ruining Deng2
Heejong Kim2  Johannes C. Paetzold1,2  Mert R. Sabuncu1,2
1Cornell Tech  2Weill Cornell Medicine  3Delft University of Technology
摘要Abstract

多目标优化 (MOO) 是许多机器学习问题的基础，但损失平衡、梯度平衡和基于 Pareto 的 MOO 求解器几乎普遍将其协调的方向交给 AdamMulti-objective optimization (MOO) underlies many machine learning problems, yet MOO solvers across the loss-balancing, gradient-balancing, and Pareto-based families almost universally hand their reconciled directions to Adam[20]。我们证明这种耦合在求解器的意图和优化器的执行之间引入了两个系统性差距。第一个是. We show this coupling introduces two systematic gaps between the solver’s intent and the optimizer’s execution. The first is a权重不匹配weighting mismatch：亚当的二阶矩分母将时变偏好向量与梯度统计纠缠在一起，将偏好边缘化为历史平均值，并将不同的帕累托权衡折叠为近乎均匀的混合物。第二个是一个: Adam’s second-moment denominator entangles the time-varying preference vector with gradient statistics, marginalizing the preference into a history average and collapsing distinct Pareto trade-offs toward a near-uniform mixture. The second is a几何失配geometric mismatch：Adam 的自适应度量扭曲了 MOO 求解器假设的欧几里得几何，将一致的目标变成了明显的冲突。 为了共同解决这两个问题，我们引入: Adam’s adaptive metric distorts the Euclidean geometry MOO solvers assume, turning aligned objectives into apparent conflicts. To resolve both jointly, we introduce女士MAdam（度量感知多目标 Adam），一个嵌入式包装器，使求解器和优化器保持不变。 MAdam 通过标量化目标的偏好条件曲率来预设协调方向；在这个白化输入上，Adam 的二阶矩崩溃为恒等式，因此实现的更新受偏好条件度量的控制。 在多任务学习、帕累托前沿恢复、物理信息神经网络和医学成像方面，MAdam 在每个求解器系列中都持续优于 Adam。 代码位于(Metric-Aware Multi-Objective Adam), a drop-in wrapper that leaves both solver and optimizer unchanged. MAdam preconditions the reconciled direction by the preference-conditioned curvature of the scalarized objective; on this whitened input, Adam’s second moment collapses to identity, so the realized update is governed by the preference-conditioned metric. Across multi-task learning, Pareto-front recovery, physics-informed neural networks, and medical imaging, MAdam consistently improves over Adam for every solver family. Code is atlink.

1 简介Introduction

许多实际的学习问题需要一个共享模型来同时满足多个目标。这样的设置自然会被视为多目标优化（MOO）。三种 MOO 求解器范式已经出现Many practical learning problems require a shared model to satisfy multiple objectives simultaneously. Such settings are naturally cast as multi-objective optimization (MOO). Three MOO solver paradigms have emerged[4]: 损失平衡loss-balancing方法调整客观权重以重新平衡梯度大小methods adapt objective weights to rebalance gradient magnitudes[44, 39, 30, 28]; 梯度平衡gradient-balancing方法修改目标梯度以减少目标间冲突methods modify objective gradients to reduce inter-objective conflict[58, 29, 32];和; and基于帕累托的Pareto-based方法将更新引导至帕累托前沿目标区域methods steer the update toward a Pareto front target region[27, 43, 9, 3]。大多数基于梯度的 MOO 求解器旨在产生单一协调方向。. Most gradient based MOO solvers aim to produce a single reconciled direction.

然而，基于梯度的优化依赖于两个步骤：However, gradient-based optimization relies on two steps:建造constructing下降方向和the descent direction and执行executing使用合适的度量进行更新，这是上述所有三个 MOO 求解器系列一致委托给 Adam 的角色the update with a suitable metric, which is a role all three MOO solver families above unanimously delegate to Adam[20]。 Adam 通过二阶矩分母隐式地施加了自己的自适应对角度量，该度量在平稳性下近似于对角经验费希尔信息矩阵. Adam implicitly imposes its own adaptive diagonal metric via the second-moment denominator, which under stationarity approximates a diagonal empirical Fisher information matrix[21, 37]。我们表明，这种默认配对在求解器的意图和优化器实际执行的内容之间引入了两个系统性的不匹配。. We show this default pairing introduces two systematic mismatches between what the solver intends and what the optimizer actually executes.

首先，在损失平衡和基于帕累托的方法中，求解器的协调方向取决于时变偏好向量Firstly, in loss-balancing and Pareto-based methods, the solver’s reconciled direction depends on a time-varying preference vector𝝀(t)\bm{\lambda}^{(t)}：损失平衡方法调整这些偏好以重新平衡梯度大小，而基于帕累托的方法调整它们以引导至目标帕累托区域。然而，亚当的运行第二矩将这些偏好与客观梯度统计数据纠缠成一个单一的替代项，削弱了预期的偏好策略并将不同的帕累托权衡压缩为接近均匀的平均值（命题: loss-balancing methods adapt these preferences to rebalance gradient magnitudes, while Pareto-based methods adjust them to steer toward a target Pareto region. However, Adam’s running second moment entangles these preferences with the objective gradient statistics into a single surrogate, weakening the intended preference strategy and collapsing distinct Pareto trade-offs into a near-uniform average (Proposition1).

其次，MOO 求解器通常假设原始欧几里得几何：损失平衡方法通过线性标量明确地对目标进行加权。梯度平衡方法测量梯度相似性并进行预测以减少欧几里得空间中的冲突。基于帕累托的方法通过用户偏好的线性标量来引导帕累托目标区域。然而，Adam 并不是度量中立的：它的二阶矩分母在每次更新时都会施加对角 RMS 度量，这与 MOO 求解器假设的欧几里得度量相冲突。这种几何不匹配扭曲了求解器的协调方向，将对齐的目标变成明显的冲突，反之亦然（命题Secondly, MOO solvers typically assume a raw Euclidean geometry: loss-balancing methods explicitly weight the objectives through linear scalarization. Gradient-balancing methods measure gradient similarities and project to reduce conflict in Euclidean space. Pareto-based methods steer a Pareto target region through linear scalarization of user preferences. However, Adam is not metric-neutral: its second-moment denominator imposes a diagonal RMS metric on every update, conflicting with the Euclidean metric assumed by MOO solvers. This geometric mismatch distorts the solver’s reconciled direction, turning aligned objectives into apparent conflicts and vice versa (Proposition2).

这些观察提出了两个问题：These observations raise two questions:Q1.哪个指标应该管理 MOO 更新？Q1. Which metric should govern MOO updates? Q2。如何在现有的求解器-Adam 管道中实现？Q2. How can it be realized within the existing solver–Adam pipeline?

我们提出了 MAdam（度量感知多目标 Adam），它用单一机制解决这两个问题。对于 Q1，我们得出We propose MAdam (Metric-aware Multi-objective Adam), which addresses both questions with a single mechanism. For Q1, we derive the偏好条件preference-conditioned主动偏好下标量化目标的对角 Fisher 信息矩阵，由标量化梯度的二阶矩给出，并允许分解为目标内和跨目标 Fisher 块。对于 Q2，我们在 Adam 更新之前通过这个对角度量来预处理求解器的协调方向，既不修改求解器也不修改优化器。在 Adam 的输入上应用修正可以保持其一阶矩和二阶矩 EMA 相互一致，因此实现的参数更新由偏好条件度量控制。我们的贡献是三重的diagonal Fisher information matrix of the scalarized objective at the active preference, given by the second moment of the scalarized gradient and admitting a decomposition into within- and cross-objective Fisher blocks. For Q2, we precondition the solver’s reconciled direction by this diagonal metric prior to the Adam update, modifying neither the solver nor the optimizer. Applying the correction at Adam’s input keeps its first- and second-moment EMAs mutually consistent, so the realized parameter update is governed by the preference-conditioned metric. Our contributions are threefold

  • •

    求解器-Adam 不匹配的诊断。Diagnosis of the solver–Adam mismatch.我们证明了 MOO 中求解器-Adam 耦合的两种失效模式：We prove two failure modes of solver–Adam coupling in MOO: a权重不匹配weighting mismatch边缘化偏好（命题that marginalizes the preference (Proposition1）和一个) and a几何失配geometric mismatch扭曲了 MOO 求解器假设的欧几里得几何（命题that distorts the Euclidean geometry assumed by MOO solvers (Proposition2).

  • •

    度量感知梯度预处理 (MAdam)。Metric-aware gradient preconditioning (MAdam).我们推导了标量化目标的偏好条件对角费舍尔，并将其用作协调方向上的即插即用预处理器，用单一机制解决了这两种不匹配问题。We derive the preference-conditioned diagonal Fisher of the scalarized objective and apply it as a plug-and-play preconditioner on the reconciled direction, resolving both mismatches with a single mechanism.

  • •

    实证验证。Empirical validation.在不同的 MOO 求解器中，MAdam 在多任务学习、Pareto 前沿恢复、PINN 基准和医学成像应用方面始终优于 Adam。Across diverse MOO solvers, MAdam consistently improves over Adam on multi-task learning, Pareto-front recovery, PINN benchmarks, and medical imaging applications.

2 相关工作Related Work

多任务和 Pareto MTL。Multi-Task and Pareto MTL.

多任务学习通过重新调整每个目标的损失、操纵任务梯度或瞄准帕累托前沿上的偏好条件点来协调竞争目标。 代表性方法包括固定或学习的标量化（线性标量化、不确定性加权Multi-task learning reconciles competing objectives by rescaling per-objective losses, manipulating task gradients, or targeting a preference-conditioned point on the Pareto front. Representative methods range from fixed or learned scalarizations (linear scalarization, uncertainty weighting[19]）通过动态调整权重（DWA) through dynamically adapted weights (DWA[33], 内皮层, IMTL[32], CAGrad [29]）到从单个网络恢复完整帕累托前沿的偏好条件模型（PaMaL) to preference-conditioned models that recover the full Pareto front from a single network (PaMaL[8], 帕洛拉, PaLoRA[9]）。 在这个家族中，构建的方向最终被 Adam 消耗，他的对角线二阶矩 EMA 与时变偏好纠缠在一起). Across this family the constructed direction is ultimately consumed by Adam, whose diagonal second-moment EMA entangles the time-varying preference𝝀(t)\bm{\lambda}^{(t)}具有每个目标的梯度统计数据，并对每个步骤施加与任务无关的 RMS 指标。with per-objective gradient statistics and imposes a task-agnostic RMS metric on each step.

PINN 和 MIA 损失平衡。PINN and MIA Loss Balancing.

物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 和医学图像分析 (MIA) 表现出密切相关的不平衡：残差、边界和重建损失跨越不同的尺度，因此单一目标在缺乏明确的重新平衡的情况下占主导地位。 PINNacle 基准测试Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and medical-image analysis (MIA) exhibit a closely related imbalance: residual, boundary, and reconstruction losses span widely different scales, so a single objective dominates absent explicit rebalancing. The PINNacle benchmark[14]沿着三个轴整合补救措施，损失重新加权（LRAconsolidates remedies along three axes, loss reweighting (LRA[51],NTK, NTK[52]），基于残差的采样（RAR), residual-based sampling (RAR[54]）和自适应激活（LAAF/GAAF), and adaptive activations (LAAF/GAAF[17]）；在《MIA》中，香草亚当); in MIA, vanilla Adam[40]和随机损失加权and random loss weighting[25]仍然是主流选择。 这种一阶补救措施会调整下降方向，但不会影响 Adam 提供的优化器的步长度量。remain the prevailing choices. Such first-order remedies adjust the descent direction yet leave the optimizer’s step metric, supplied by Adam, untouched.

曲率感知优化器。Curvature-Aware Optimizers.

独立的曲率感知优化器系列，跨越自然梯度A separate line of curvature-aware optimizers, spanning natural gradient[1, 37],K-FAC, K-FAC[38], 洗发水, Shampoo[13], 阿达黑森, AdaHessian[57], 索菲亚, Sophia[31]、 和 FAdam, and FAdam[16]，针对单个标量目标并批量取代一阶优化器。 没有一个在时变偏好下预先确定多目标求解器的协调方向。 MAdam 填补了这一空白：它派生出标量化目标的偏好条件对角费舍尔，并将其作为包装器插入到求解器-然后-Adam 管道中，从而使 MOO 求解器和优化器保持完整。 App 中提供了 MTL、PINN、MIA 和曲率感知方法的完整列表。, targets a single scalar objective and supplants the first-order optimizer wholesale. None preconditions the reconciled direction of a multi-objective solver under a time-varying preference. MAdam occupies this gap: it derives a preference-conditioned diagonal Fisher of the scalarized objective and inserts it into the solver-then-Adam pipeline as a wrapper, leaving both the MOO solver and the optimizer intact. A comprehensive listing of MTL, PINN, MIA, and curvature-aware methods is in App.A.

基线与基线+女士。Baselines vs. Baselines + MAdam.

我们将 MAdam 应用于代表性的 MOO 求解器和来自每个机制的训练方案，将所有其他设置固定在基线/MAdam 块内。对于 MTL 和 Pareto MTL，我们遵循 PaLoRA 的配方（学习率、主干、批量大小、进度、每个目标损失），并与标准 MTL 求解器线性标量化 (LS)、不确定性加权 (UW) 进行比较We apply MAdam on top of representative MOO solvers and training recipes from each regime, holding all other settings fixed within a baseline/MAdam block. For both MTL and Pareto MTL we follow PaLoRA’s recipe (learning rate, backbone, batch size, schedule, per-objective losses) and compare against the standard MTL solvers linear scalarization (LS), Uncertainty Weighting (UW)[19], 动态平均权重 (DWA), Dynamic Weight Average (DWA)[33], 公正 MTL (IMTL), Impartial MTL (IMTL)[32]和 CAGrad, and CAGrad[29]对于单一权衡设置，并针对 Pareto 前沿求解器 PaMaLfor the single-trade-off setting, and against the Pareto-front solvers PaMaL[8]和帕洛拉and PaLoRA[9]为偏好条件设置。对于 PINN，我们跨越 PINNacle 的三个基线系列：Vanilla (PINN)、损失重新加权/采样 (LRAfor the preference-conditioned setting. For PINNs we span PINNacle’s three baseline families: Vanilla (PINN), Loss Reweighting/Sampling (LRA[51],NTK, NTK[52],RAR, RAR[54]）和自适应激活（LAAF/GAAF), and adaptive activations (LAAF/GAAF[17]）。对于皮肤病变分割，我们在 UNet 下将 MAdam 与 Adam 进行比较). For skin-lesion segmentation we compare MAdam against Adam under UNet[42]和 SwinTransformerand SwinTransformer[34]。对于超分辨率，我们与 Adam 领导下的 UW 和 LS 进行比较。所有实验均在PyTorch中实现. MAdam improves the base solver in aggregate on every benchmark: it strictly dominates all three task accuracies on𝙼𝚞𝚕𝚝𝚒𝙼𝙽𝙸𝚂𝚃\mathtt{MultiMNIST}，大多数每个关节的错误, the majority of per-joint errors on𝚂𝙰𝚁𝙲𝙾𝚂\mathtt{SARCOS}，分割和深度, both segmentation and depth on𝙲𝚒𝚝𝚢𝚜𝚌𝚊𝚙𝚎𝚜\mathtt{Cityscapes}—它减少了 IMTL 相对深度误差—where it reduces IMTL relative depth error from74.274.2 to 61.861.8——以及大多数指标—and the majority of metrics on𝙽𝚈𝚄𝚟𝟸\mathtt{NYUv2}适用于 LS、DWA、IMTL 和 CAGrad。当基础求解器已经提供强大的任务平衡并且剩余差距在一个标准差以内时，就会出现其余的例外情况。这些结果表明，MAdam 充当嵌入式预处理器，不会降低所考虑的任何基准的平均任务性能。for LS, DWA, IMTL, and CAGrad. The remaining exceptions arise when the base solver already supplies strong task balancing, and the residual gaps lie within one standard deviation. These results indicate that MAdam acts as a drop-in preconditioner that does not degrade average task performance on any benchmark considered.

消融研究Ablation studies

我们在 LS 下依次停用 MAdam 的三个组件We deactivate each of MAdam’s three components in turn under LS on𝚂𝙰𝚁𝙲𝙾𝚂\mathtt{SARCOS}（标签。(Tab.5）。禁用斜坡上升是最具破坏性的：在每个目标 Fisher 估计稳定之前启用预处理器会使性能下降到 LS 基线以下。对目标对的完整二次枚举与二次成本下的完整方法相匹配，验证随机采样作为无偏估计量。限制对角费舍尔同样会削弱增益，表明冲突目标之间的非对角曲率做出了有意义的贡献。完整的方法获得了最强的总体性能和最低的种子方差。). Disabling the rampup is most damaging: engaging the preconditioner before per-objective Fisher estimates stabilize drops performance below the LS baseline. Full quadratic enumeration over objective pairs matches the full method at quadratic cost, validating stochastic sampling as an unbiased estimator. Restricting to the diagonal Fisher similarly erodes the gain, indicating off-diagonal curvature between conflicting objectives contributes meaningfully. The full method attains the strongest aggregate performance and lowest variance across seeds.

5 结论Conclusion

我们引入了 MAdam（度量感知多目标 Adam），它是一个嵌入式包装器，可以解决求解器 Adam 管道中的两个不匹配问题：We introduced MAdam (Metric-Aware Multi-Objective Adam), a drop-in wrapper that resolves two mismatches in the solver–Adam pipeline: a权重不匹配weighting mismatch亚当的历史平均第二时刻，以及with Adam’s history-averaged second moment, and a几何失配geometric mismatch与 MOO 求解器假定的欧几里得几何。通过偏好条件对角费舍尔对协调方向进行预处理，使 Adam 的二阶矩塌陷到恒等式，从而使更新由偏好条件度量控制。在多任务学习、Pareto 前沿恢复、PINN 和医学成像方面，MAdam 在各种 MOO 求解器上始终优于 Adam。with the Euclidean geometry assumed by MOO solvers. Preconditioning the reconciled direction by the preference-conditioned diagonal Fisher collapses Adam’s second moment to identity, leaving the update governed by the preference-conditioned metric. Across multi-task learning, Pareto-front recovery, PINNs, and medical imaging, MAdam consistently improves over Adam for diverse MOO solvers.

局限性和未来的工作。Limitations and future work.

仍然存在两个限制。首先，对于异构目标（例如，分类与回归配对），我们对非对角线块的估计Two limitations remain. First, for heterogeneous objectives (e.g., classification paired with regression), our estimate of the off-diagonal blocks𝐅i​j\mathbf{F}_{ij}不是最佳的，条目往往很小且有噪音；我们计划开发更有原则的跨目标曲率估计器。其次，我们的推导假设线性标量化is sub-optimal, with entries that tend to be small and noisy; we plan to develop more principled estimators of cross-objective curvature. Second, our derivation assumes a linear scalarization∑iλi​ℒi\sum_{i}\lambda_{i}\mathcal{L}_{i};我们计划将 MAdam 扩展到非线性标量化，例如 Tchebycheff 标量化; we plan to extend MAdam to nonlinear scalarizations such as Tchebycheff scalarization[28].

多任务和 Pareto MTL。Multi-Task and Pareto MTL.

MTL 方法通过重塑每个目标的损失权重、投影或旋转任务梯度或转向权衡方面的偏好条件点来协调多个目标，然后将结果方向交给通用优化器。 我们在实验中比较的基线是线性标量（LS），即等权和； 不确定性加权MTL methods reconcile multiple objectives by reshaping per-objective loss weights, projecting or rotating task gradients, or steering toward a preference-conditioned point on the trade-off front, and then hand the resulting direction to a generic optimizer. The baselines we compare against in experiments are Linear Scalarization (LS), the equal-weight sum; Uncertainty Weighting[19]，从同方差噪声中得出权重； 动态平均体重, which derives weights from homoscedastic noise; Dynamic Weight Average[33]，根据最近的损失比率重新加权； IMTL, which reweights by recent loss ratios; IMTL[32]，对损失尺度 (IMTL-L) 和每目标梯度规范 (IMTL-G) 进行归一化； 大学毕业生, which normalizes loss scale (IMTL-L) and per-objective gradient norms (IMTL-G); CAGrad[29]，最大化最坏情况任务的改进； 帕玛尔, which maximizes the worst-case task improvement; PaMaL[8]，它将 Pareto 解决方案构建为单任务模型的偏好加权集成； 和帕洛拉, which builds Pareto solutions as preference-weighted ensembles of single-task models; and PaLoRA[9]，它将偏好调节扩展到低等级适配器，以便改变, which extends preference conditioning to low-rank adapters so that varying𝝀\bm{\lambda}推论追踪整个帕累托前沿。 除此之外，更广泛的类别包括损失平衡方法，例如 GradNormat inference traces the entire Pareto front. Beyond these, the broader category includes loss-balancing methods such as GradNorm[5], 法莫, FAMO[30], 平滑切比雪夫标量化, Smooth Tchebycheff scalarization[28], DB-MTL [26]。 梯度平衡方法，例如 PCGrad. gradient-balancing methods such as PCGrad[58], 梯度真空, GradVac[53],纳什-MTL, Nash-MTL[39], 旋转梯度, RotoGrad[18], 对齐-MTL, Aligned-MTL[45], 梯度下降, GradDrop[47]，和标签, and TAG[11]; 多任务优化器变体 MTAdam; multi-task optimizer variants MTAdam[36]和 AdaTaskand AdaTask[56]; 和附加帕累托前沿求解器 MGDA; and additional Pareto-front solvers MGDA[44],PMTL, PMTL[27], 欧洲专利局, EPO[35], 宇宙, COSMOS[43]、费雷罗, and FERERO[3]。 在所有这些中，构造的方向然后由 Adam 提交，其对角二阶矩 EMA 合并了时变偏好. Across all of these, the constructed direction is then committed by Adam, whose diagonal second-moment EMA conflates the time-varying preference𝝀(t)\bm{\lambda}^{(t)}具有每个目标的梯度统计数据，并对执行的步骤施加与任务无关的 RMS 度量，因此求解器的规定权重和方向会被此处每种方法默认的优化器度量所扭曲。with per-objective gradient statistics and imposes a task-agnostic RMS metric on the executed step, so the solver’s prescribed weighting and direction are distorted by the metric of the optimizer that every method here defaults to.

PINN 和 MIA 损失平衡。PINN and MIA Loss Balancing.

物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 和医学图像分析 (MIA) 训练面临着一个密切相关的问题：PINN 中的残差、边界和初始条件损失，以及 MIA 中的感知、结构和像素重建损失，存在于截然不同的尺度上，因此除非明确重新平衡，否则单个目标主导训练。 对于 PINN，我们根据三个 PINNacle 进行评估Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and medical-image analysis (MIA) training confront a closely related problem: residual, boundary, and initial-condition losses in PINNs, and perceptual, structural, and pixel-wise reconstruction losses in MIA, live on widely different scales, so a single objective dominates training unless explicitly rebalanced. For PINNs we evaluate against the three PINNacle[14]家庭：香草 PINNfamilies: the vanilla PINN[41]，训练网络以满足均匀加权下的偏微分方程残差和边界/初始条件损失； 圣主抵抗军, which trains a network to satisfy the PDE residual and boundary/initial-condition losses under uniform weighting; LRA[51]，它根据梯度幅值统计调整损失权重； NTK, which adapts loss weights from gradient-magnitude statistics; NTK[52]，它从每个损失项的神经正切核导出每个损失权重； RAR, which derives per-loss weights from the Neural Tangent Kernel of each loss term; RAR[54]，通过残差幅度自适应地对残差搭配点进行重采样； 和 LAAF / GAAF, which adaptively resamples residual collocation points by residual magnitude; and LAAF / GAAF[17]，它通过局部和全局自适应激活函数而不是权重来改变表达性。 对于 MIA，我们与普通 Adam 进行比较, which alter expressivity through locally and globally adaptive activation functions rather than weights. For MIA we compare against vanilla Adam[40]在大学网上on UNet[42]和 SwinTransformerand SwinTransformer[34]骨干，并反对 RLWbackbones, and against RLW[25]，它通过随机抽取定期重新加权损失。 PINNacle 中调查的其他方法，包括因果训练、时间推进计划和进一步采样策略，都具有相同的一阶精神，不再单独列举。 这些方法正确地诊断了损失不平衡，并通过一阶补救措施（权重、样本或激活）来解决它，但没有任何方法修改执行重新平衡方向的几何结构； Adam 提供的优化器步骤指标保持不变，即使它定义的损失情况是不平衡的根源。, which periodically reweights losses by random draws. Other methods surveyed in PINNacle, including causal training, time-marching schedules, and further sampling strategies, share the same first-order spirit and are not separately enumerated. These methods correctly diagnose loss-imbalance and address it with first-order remedies (weights, samples, or activations), but none modifies the geometry under which the rebalanced direction is executed; the optimizer’s step metric, supplied by Adam, is left untouched even when the loss landscape it defines is the source of the imbalance.

曲率感知优化器。Curvature-Aware Optimizers.

一项单独的工作从二阶或费舍尔信息而不是原始梯度中导出参数更新，旨在通过完全替换一阶优化器来加速单个标量目标的收敛。 在我们的实验中，这些方法均未用作基线，但它们在公制轴上形成了与 MAdam 最近的邻居。 自然梯度下降A separate line of work derives parameter updates from second-order or Fisher information rather than the raw gradient, aiming to accelerate convergence on a single scalar objective by replacing the first-order optimizer altogether. None of these methods is used as a baseline in our experiments, but they form the closest neighbor to MAdam on the metric axis. Natural gradient descent[1, 37]通过Fisher信息矩阵对更新进行前置； K-FACpreconditions the update by the Fisher information matrix; K-FAC[38]使用 EKFAC 以克罗内克因子形式逐层近似费舍尔approximates this Fisher in a Kronecker-factored form layer-wise, with EKFAC[12]将因式分解扩展到其特征基； 洗发水extending the factorization to its eigenbasis; Shampoo[13]沿每个张量轴维护完整的预处理器，并且 SOAPmaintains full preconditioners along each tensor axis, and SOAP[50]用 Adam 的自适应缩放组成 Shampoo 的预处理器； 阿达·黑森composes Shampoo’s preconditioner with Adam’s adaptive scaling; AdaHessian[57]通过 Hutchinson 采样估计 Hessian 对角线，Sophiaestimates the Hessian diagonal via Hutchinson sampling, and Sophia[31]裁剪稳定语言模型预训练的对角 Hessian 估计； 法达姆clips the diagonal Hessian estimate for stable language-model pretraining; FAdam[16]将 Adam 本身重新解释为对角经验费舍尔自然梯度优化器，以及最近的对角费舍尔估计器reinterprets Adam itself as a diagonal empirical-Fisher natural-gradient optimizer, and recent diagonal-Fisher estimators[47, 24, 55]锐化 Adam 已经隐式使用的替代物，同时sharpen the surrogate Adam already implicitly uses, whileKunstner et al. [21]警告不要将亚当的分母视为通用费舍尔代理。 所有这些方法都针对单个标量目标，并通过用曲率感知优化器替换一阶优化器进行干预；没有一个会在时变偏好下预先确定多目标求解器的协调方向。 MAdam 在范围和集成方面有所不同：它派生出标量化目标的偏好条件对角费舍尔，并将其作为包装器插入到求解器-然后-Adam 管道中，使 MOO 求解器和优化器保持不变。cautions against treating Adam’s denominator as a generic Fisher proxy. All of these methods target a single scalar objective and intervene by replacing the first-order optimizer with a curvature-aware one; none preconditions the reconciled direction of a multi-objective solver under a time-varying preference. MAdam differs in both scope and integration: it derives a preference-conditioned diagonal Fisher of the scalarized objective and slots it into the solver-then-Adam pipeline as a wrapper, leaving both the MOO solver and the optimizer untouched.

G.2 物理信息神经网络 (PINN)Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs)

我们使用 PINNacle 基准测试We use the PINNacle benchmark[14]与with2020偏微分方程案例涵盖伯格、热、泊松、波、纳维-斯托克斯、混沌系统以及高维泊松和热族。对于每个偏微分方程，神经网络PDE cases spanning Burgers, heat, Poisson, wave, Navier–Stokes, chaotic systems, and high-dimensional Poisson and heat families. For each PDE, the neural networku𝜽u_{\bm{\theta}}被训练以满足内部控制方程以及特定问题的边界、初始、周期和观察约束。因此，每个偏微分方程都会引发一个多目标问题，其目标是构成残差和约束损失，所有这些自然都在不同且随时间变化的尺度上。is trained to satisfy the governing equation in the interior together with the problem-specific boundary, initial, periodic, and observation constraints. Each PDE therefore induces a multi-objective problem whose objectives are the constituent residual and constraint losses, all naturally on different and time-varying scales.

  • •

    任务（根据偏微分方程）：Tasks (per PDE):每项任务对应一个残差或约束损失。根据 PDE，这包括一个或多个 PDE 剩余损失Each task corresponds to one residual or constraint loss. Depending on the PDE, this includes one or more PDE residual lossesℓPDE\ell_{\mathrm{PDE}}关于内部配置点、边界条件损失on interior collocation points, boundary-condition lossesℓBC\ell_{\mathrm{BC}}, 初始条件损失, initial-condition lossesℓIC\ell_{\mathrm{IC}}、周期性损失和点观测约束损失。任务丢失的数量取决于 PDE，范围为, periodicity losses, and point-observation constraint losses. The number of task losses is PDE-dependent and ranges from22 to 1111跨越活跃的across the active2020PINNacle 案例。PINNacle cases.

G.3 医学图像分析Medical Image Analysis

我们根据两个医学成像基准对 MAdam 进行评估，其中多目标公式源自We evaluate MAdam on two medical-imaging benchmarks in which the multi-objective formulation arises from损失分解loss decomposition而不是来自多个监督任务：皮肤病变分割rather than from multiple supervised tasks: skin-lesion segmentation on𝙸𝚂𝙸𝙲𝟸𝟶𝟷𝟾\mathtt{ISIC2018}和脑 MRI 超分辨率and brain-MRI super-resolution on𝙾𝙰𝚂𝙸𝚂𝟹\mathtt{OASIS3}。在这两种设置中，成分损失的尺度明显不同，并且具有性质不同的梯度分布，暴露了第 2 节中分析的一阶矩滞后。. In both settings the constituent losses sit on markedly different scales and have qualitatively different gradient distributions, exposing the first-moment lag analyzed in Sec.3.2同时保持干净的低维 MOO 测试平台。while remaining clean low-dimensional MOO testbeds.
